theorem prop_11_2_3' {α x n w₀ w₁ : ℝ} {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n (x / κ)) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hw₀1 : w₀ ≤ 1) (hw₁ : 1 ≤ w₁)
    (hy : 2.16e20 ≤ w₀ * (x / κ)) (hn : 670 ≤ w₀ * n)
    (hG1 : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, min 1 w * n ≤ (w * (x / κ)) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 →
      gx (w * (x / κ)) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G w)
    (hG2 : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, 0.276 * (w * (x / κ)) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * (x / κ)) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * (x / κ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * (x / κ)) ≤ G w * (w * (x / κ)))
    (hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => G w * phi w) (Icc w₀ w₁)) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ((∫ w in Icc w₀ w₁, G w * phi w) +
      17 * ((∫ w in Ioo 0 w₀, phi w) + ∫ w in Ioi w₁, phi w)) :=

note: Erratum: The first case (11.18)–(11.19) omits the term C_{φ,0,K} = 1.04488∫₀^{1/K}φ that its proof produces and the second case keeps; for a continuous φ concentrated near w = 2.75/x (x = 10³⁰, K = 8, q = 8·10⁸, δ = 0), |S_{η*}(α,x)| ≥ 0.18|φ|₁x while g_{x,φ}(q)|φ|₁x ≤ 0.01|φ|₁x (proved by `Companion.Book.prop_11_2_3_false` in `lean/Companion/Book/Prop_11_2_3.lean`).
